[_Perdition_](https://open.spotify.com/album/392ZRhcHTV2pTYmqXwUjp3?si=UX28SRR2TOaTA1mvMaQu4A) is one of my favorite (if not thee favorite) screamo albums ever, the whole thing through. This song is probably my favorite on the album, because of the combination of the music, lyrics, and the way they're sung. They make you visualize actual gears churning while hitting deep.

> "Cause it was us rebuilding this machine."
